نصطخم (form VIII)
# نَصْطَخِمُ (naṣṭaḵimu) /nasˤ.tˤa.xi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# نَصْطَخِمَ (naṣṭaḵima) /nasˤ.tˤa.xi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# نَصْطَخِمْ (naṣṭaḵim) /nasˤ.tˤa.xim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
